title.en: The Moon and the Bonfires: five complete new editions

summary.en: Four essays on origins, memory and the village. Five complete new editions follow Chinese prose checked against the Italian novel, with corresponding factual repairs in the independent English essays.
summary.zh: 四篇据意大利原作核修来处、亲事、火灾与结尾，保留散文论线，补齐日法德西韩全文与八语入口。
summary.zh-hant: 四篇據意大利原作核修來處、親事、火災與結尾，保留散文論線，補齊日法德西韓全文與八語入口。
